question: Should CodexBar expose a user-adjustable 1–12 Overview row cap now, independently of the compact-density work tracked by https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2107?
rationale: The related canonical request describes the cap as a partial UX lever and leaves the appropriate range and density tradeoff to product judgment; no maintainer approval is visible in this PR discussion.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded configurable cap
options.body: Accept the setting as a separately useful feature, but require observed menu invalidation, regression coverage, real app proof, and a maintainer-approved range.

options.title: Defer to compact-density design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue as the product vehicle and defer this preference until the Overview density behavior and cap are designed together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded configurable cap
recommendation.body: Accept the setting as a separately useful feature, but require observed menu invalidation, regression coverage, real app proof, and a maintainer-approved range.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available history-backed contributor for the original merged Overview feature and its provider-selection controls.
